quar.perm_bot: I need the "Manage Roles" permission to remove and give back roles.
quar.membre_requis: Enter the member in the `membre` option.
quar.pas_configure: No isolated role is set (or it no longer exists). Choose it first with `/quarantaine action:config`.
quar.role_invalide: This role cannot be the isolated role (@everyone and integration-managed roles are excluded).
quar.role_pouvoir: This role has dangerous permissions (administrator, moderation, server management, mentioning everyone…). An isolated member must not be able to do anything: remove them first.

quar.role_superieur: This role is higher than or equal to your highest role: you can't choose it.
quar.role_bot: I can't give this role: I need "Manage Roles" and a role placed above it.

quar.config_ok: Isolated role saved: {role}. Remember to remove its access to the channels isolated members must not see.
quar.config_aucune: No isolated role is set. Choose it with `/quarantaine action:config role:...`.
quar.pas_gerable: I can't change this member's roles (their role is higher than or equal to mine).
quar.deja: This member is already in quarantine.
quar.echec: Discord refused the role change: the member is not in quarantine and nothing was saved.

quar.mp_ok: The member was notified by direct message.
quar.mp_ko: The member could not be notified by direct message.
quar.mp:
You have been put in quarantine on the server **{serveur}**: your roles are removed until a moderator decides otherwise.
Reason: ***{reason}***
quar.pas_en_quarantaine: This member is not in quarantine.
quar.lever_superieur: The role {role}, saved for this member, is higher than or equal to your highest role: a higher-ranked moderator must lift this quarantine. Nothing was changed.
quar.echec_lever: Discord refused the role change: the quarantine is still in place, you can try again.
quar.levee: {moderateur} lifted the quarantine of {user}: {n} role(s) given back.
quar.levee_absent: {user} is no longer on the server: the saved roles have been deleted.
quar.levee_supprimes: {n} saved role(s) no longer exist and were not given back.
quar.levee_impossibles: {n} role(s) could not be given back (integration role or above my role).
quar.refus_roles: You are in quarantine: you cannot give yourself a role until a moderator lifts the measure.
